title: FOR Loops

story.introduction:
Day 12 on planet Syntax-IV. The ship's systems need repetitive checks on multiple components.

"PROTO-7, diagnostics can't check systems one by one forever. Time to learn FOR loops - the power of iteration!"

"One loop can check ten systems. One hundred. One thousand. This is automation at its finest."
story.context: FOR loops enable iteration over ranges, lists, and sequences. Write the logic once, execute it repeatedly with different data.

learningObjectives: Understand FOR loop syntax and structure
Use FOR...IN RANGE for numeric iteration
Iterate over list variables with FOR...IN
Use FOR...IN ENUMERATE for index + value
Master loop indentation and END keyword
